quote: Note. Unstandardised regression coefficients are reported. Pre-to-post was coded pre-intervention = 0 and post-intervention = 1.
reason: Published p. 7 reports unstandardised regression coefficients and simple-slope estimates across four outcomes ("Generalized linear mixed model predicting doping likelihood (N = 118)" in Table 3 and "Anticipated Guilt Moral Disengagement Self-regulatory efficacy" in Table 4) for two time intervals and two condition contrasts (Contrast 1 interventions vs. control and Contrast 2 psychological vs. educational), without any neutral locator specifying the target outcome, contrast, or time window. A broad paper-level narrative conclusion cannot be assigned to an unidentified regression coefficient.
